title: Sierpiński carpet
rule: Remove the middle ninth of every square, forever. The area tends to zero.
alt: Sierpiński carpet of cyan dots

title: Rule 30
rule: new = left XOR (centre OR right), from a single lit cell.
alt: Rule 30 triangle of grey and magenta dots

title: Packard snowflake
rule: A hexagonal cell freezes when exactly one neighbour is frozen.
alt: Hexagonal snowflake of grey dots with cyan tips

title: Diffusion-limited aggregation
rule: Random walkers stick wherever they touch the cluster.
alt: Branching grey cluster with blue tips

title: Langton's ant
rule: White: turn right. Black: turn left. Flip the square, step.
alt: Langton's ant cluster with diagonal highways

title: Flocking
rule: Separation, alignment, cohesion. And one predator.
alt: Flock of dot birds in pink, green and cyan

title: Physarum
rule: Agents sense trail ahead, turn to the strongest, step, deposit more.
alt: Glowing blue and yellow veins of a slime mould network

title: Recursive trees
rule: Every branch is a smaller, turned copy of the whole tree.
alt: Two recursive trees, blue to green to pink

title: Reaction–diffusion
rule: Gray–Scott model, feed 0.0545, kill 0.062. Colour marks when each cell switched on.
alt: Gray–Scott reaction-diffusion bands in pink, yellow and cyan

title: Sunflower
rule: Seed n at n × 137.5°, radius ∝ √n. Spirals of 34 and 55.
alt: Sunflower spirals of pink and yellow dots

title: Nautilus shell
rule: Logarithmic spiral, ×φ² per turn, 34 chamber walls per turn.
alt: Nautilus shell spiral with coloured chamber walls

title: Double helix
rule: A–T in pink and yellow, G–C in blue and cyan, one rung per base pair.
alt: DNA double helix in white dots with coloured rungs

title: Contact map
rule: A generated fold, helices at 3.6 residues per turn; residue i lights up where it touches j.
alt: Protein contact map: green blocks and diagonals of dots

title: Black smoker
rule: Mineral plumes rising from vents on the deep-sea floor.
alt: Two hydrothermal vents with rising plumes of dots

title: Vent coral
rule: Trunks fork into smaller tilted copies; every tip is a chimney.
alt: A coral of vents in dim blue and pink dots

title: Brain slice
rule: Folds where a noise field crosses zero; activity drifts on top.
alt: Brain MRI slice with false-colour activity

title: Rings
rule: Concentric interference rings, like contour lines on a loss surface.
alt: Concentric green interference rings

title: Loss landscape
rule: Gradient descent with momentum, settling in a valley, then starting over.
alt: Dotted terrain with a white descending path

title: Embedding space
rule: Scattered points pulled into six clusters, three blobs and three filaments.
alt: Clusters of coloured dots in space

title: Denoising
rule: Pure noise, seven seconds of denoising, a mountain, then noise again.
alt: A dotted mountain peak with a moon

title: Aligning field
rule: Post-training as a picture: a wave turns every stroke the same way.
alt: A field of pink strokes turning to one direction

title: Through the grid
rule: An endless 3D lattice, flown through at 1.2 layers per second.
alt: Endless 3D grid of glowing dots

title: Chip die
rule: A recursive floorplan whose core is a copy of the whole chip.
alt: Chip die floorplan in neon colours

title: Grid wave
rule: A halftone wave rolling through a field of dots.
alt: Halftone wave of blue dots

title: Turbulent ocean
rule: Ridged noise in three octaves, looping every twelve seconds.
alt: Turbulent ocean of indigo to cyan dots

title: Strange attractor
rule: Lorenz system: σ = 10, ρ = 28, β = 8⁄3.
alt: Lorenz attractor in coloured dots

title: Spiral galaxy
rule: Two logarithmic arms, a bulge, a haze of disc stars; one turn every two minutes.
alt: Spiral galaxy with a golden core

title: Synchronised arms
rule: Every joint swings on a sine; the phase between neighbours drifts into unison.
alt: Row of pink robot arms moving in unison

title: Robot arm
rule: Forward kinematics in 3D: a jointed arm reaching for a cube.
alt: Magenta 3D robot arm reaching for a cube

title: Moiré
rule: Two identical dot lattices, rotated a few degrees apart.
alt: Moiré of pink and cyan dot lattices
